items.title: Stocks rebound after tech selloff that pushed Nasdaq into correction
items.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq edged up in early trading after a Thursday rout driven by concerns about a potential slowdown in data center construction.

items.title: ASX falls as $3.6tn global sell-off hits
items.summary: Initial euphoria over a US Democratic “blue wave” has turned to panic, wiping an estimated $US2.5 trillion from the Nasdaq and dragging the ASX lower.

items.title: Qantas flags fare increases and flight cuts as fuel prices surge
items.summary: The Middle East war continues to weigh on Qantas, despite strong demand for air travel.

aus.headline: ASX Pulled Down By Global Rout
aus.body: The ASX closed lower as a global sell-off, led by US tech, wiped trillions off shares.
aus.why: A US market rout flowed straight into Australian share prices.

us.headline: Wall Street Steadies After Rout
us.body: US shares inched higher a day after a tech rout sent the Nasdaq into a correction.
us.why: US tech moves often set the tone for the ASX the next day.

biz.headline: Qantas Flags Dearer Fares
biz.body: Qantas warned of higher fares and fewer flights as fuel prices surge.
biz.why: Australian travellers could pay more and have fewer flights to choose.
